claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing elapsed_days family fits this item, but the Dhall worker emits an omitted field for None while the tracer only accepts null for the full-refill case. The surface needs one stable representation for 'full refill after N days' that survives Dhall-to-JSON and tracer consumption.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.
